Maya (CS): FYI — SaffronAI is moving ahead with an org-wide rollout of the search assistant. Starting with 4 teams (Search, Support, Catalog, Fraud) next quarter. They're estimating ~120 devs onboarded and a peak of ~3k embedding lookups/sec + ~60k gen tokens/min. Asking us to pre-provision and advise on latency/SLA.

Liam (AE): Nice signal. Renewal window? committed usage today?

Maya (CS): Renewal ~7 months out. Current usage is tiny (dev/dev). This looks like a >10x expansion if they go full. They asked about Dedicated vs hosted burst.

Diego (SE): 3k qps embeddings + 60k tpm gen is nontrivial. Recommend a Dedicated pilot with autoscale + prefix/KV caching and eu-west1 colocated nodes to hit their <30ms embed latency target. I'll draft perf/cost plan.

Priya (OnboardPM): I'll run enablement — 2 hands-on workshops (platform + prompt engineering) and an ops runbook. Need a timeline and eng contacts so we can lock dates.

Eli (SaffronAI): Confirming numbers are intentionally conservative. Timeline: alpha in ~7 weeks, full launch in 12. We need SSO + VPC peering, and SLA language. Latency is a hard requirement.

Maya (CS): Adding infra/security tags. @Diego can you confirm whether eu-west1 placement + Dedicated is enough for their latency at that scale? infra-bot created ticket INC-4382 for VPC/peering kickoff: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4382

Diego (SE): Quick check — with KV/prefix caching and small model variants for short responses we should meet 30ms median for embeddings if we colocate. I'll post a perf plan with node counts and expected hit ratios by Tue. Sample config I'll include: 
```
- Dedicated pilot: 2 x A10-equivalent nodes
- KV cache size: 200k keys (prefetch top prefixes)
- Autoscale up to 6 nodes under sustained peak
```

Liam (AE): I'll prepare a pilot proposal + pricing (monthly pilot + conversion path to Reserved). If they greenlight the pilot this is highly likely to convert.

Priya (OnboardPM): Draft calendar uploaded to SaffronAI folder and invites sent to Eli. Need an engineering contact for webhook retry semantics and telemetry.

Eli (SaffronAI): Looped in Sarah (eng lead) for traffic profiles. Sarah will share traffic traces and SLA requirements next week.

Sarah (SaffronAI Eng): Hi all — we'll export 7 days of trace and qps histograms by Monday. Also confirm we want burst capacity for Black Friday-style spikes later in the year.

Maya (CS): Next steps: Diego posts perf plan by Tue (1859999999 + 2d), Liam sends pilot pricing by Wed, Priya confirms workshop dates. I'll set weekly check-ins with SaffronAI. Flagging as high-priority expansion signal. :thumbsup:
